recipes.name: Rabbit inspired by The Sopranos

To taste freshly ground black pepper
instructions: For the Parmesan Risotto
In a large saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons butter and 1 tablespoon olive oil. - 2 tbsp unsalted butter divided - 1 tbsp olive oil divided
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent and tender, about 3-5 minutes. - ½ large white onion finely chopped
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. - 2 cloves garlic crushed
Add the Arborio rice and saute until the edges of the rice become translucent, about 3 minutes. - 1 cup Arborio rice
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid has mostly evaporated. - 1 tbsp dry white wine

Add the heated stock one large ladle-full at a time. Most of the liquid should be evaporated before adding another ladle of stock. Make sure to keep the risotto at a simmer and to stir constantly during the cooking process. - 3 ½ cup homemade chicken stock heated
After about 15-20 minutes, the risotto should be al dente and all of the stock incorporated.

Turn off the heat, and add the cheese, 1 tablespoon olive oil, and 1 tablespoon butter. Season to taste with salt and pepper, serve immediately. - 1 oz parmesan cheese grated - 1 tbsp olive oil divided - 1 tbsp unsalted butter divided - To taste kosher salt - To taste freshly ground black pepper
For the Coniglio Della Famiglia
Cut the rabbit into sections using a meat cleaver (see video for tips). Season the sections with salt. - 1 rabbit - As needed kosher salt

Heat oil in a large skillet. Sear rabbit pieces on each side for about 3-4 minutes or until well browned. Transfer the rabbit to a separate plate once seared. - 2 tbsp As needed cooking olive oil - 1 rabbit

Add the pancetta to the pan and cook for 4-5 minutes or until crispy and the fat has rendered out. Remove the pancetta from the pan and transfer it to a separate plate. Deglaze the pan with 1-2 tablespoons of water. - 3 oz pancetta cubed
Add another tablespoon of oil to the pan, then add the onion. Cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes. - As needed cooking olive oil - 1 onion diced
Add the celery and carrots and cook for another 4-5 minutes. - 1 carrot diced - 1 celery rib chopped
Meanwhile, combine the herbs in a bowl. - 2 tsp fresh rosemary finely chopped - 2 tsp fresh sage finely chopped - 1 tsp fresh thyme finely chopped
Add the garlic to the pan and a sprinkling of the herb mixture. Cook for 30 seconds or until fragrant. - 3 cloves garlic minced
Add the canned tomatoes and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the juices begin to evaporate. - 1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes drained
Add the wine and cook for 2-3 minutes to allow the alcohol to burn off. - ¼ cup dry red wine
Add the rabbit back to the pan along with the pancetta. - 1 rabbit - 3 oz pancetta cubed
Add the chicken stock, then cover the pan and cook for 30 minutes undisturbed. - 1 cup chicken stock preferably homemade
Turn the rabbit pieces over and add another sprinkling of the herb mixture. Cover the pan and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the cover and cook for 5 minutes until the sauce is reduced.
Add pine nuts and season to taste with salt and pepper. - ½ cup pine nuts toasted - As needed kosher salt - To taste freshly ground black pepper
Serve the rabbit over a bed of risotto. - Parmesan Risotto (see above)
